summary: Sporting News's Week 14 fantasy football PPR wide receiver rankings, published Dec. 7, 2023, for the final regular-season week in most leagues. Only the Commanders and Cardinals are on bye, and Justin Jefferson returns for the first time since Week 5. The article covers top starters, waiver sleepers, busts, injuries, and a ranked list of 82 receivers.
one_line: Sporting News ranks Week 14 PPR fantasy wide receivers, led by Tyreek Hill, with Justin Jefferson returning, plus sleepers, busts and injuries.
key_facts: Only the Commanders and Cardinals are on bye in Week 14, removing Terry McLaurin, Marquise Brown, Jahan Dotson, Curtis Samuel, Rondale Moore, and Greg Dortch.
Justin Jefferson returns for the first time since Week 5; in his four full games this year he averaged just over eight receptions and 135.8 yards per game with three total touchdowns.
Tyreek Hill (vs. Titans) is the unquestioned WR1 after five catches, 157 yards, and two TDs against the Commanders.
CeeDee Lamb (vs. Eagles) is ranked WR2, and Amon-Ra St. Brown (@ Bears) is WR3; St. Brown had nine catches for 95 yards against the Bears in Week 11.
Stefon Diggs (@ Chiefs) hasn't had 100-plus receiving yards in any of his past six games.
Preferred PPR waiver pickups are Elijah Moore, Noah Brown, Odell Beckham Jr., Jonathan Mingo, and Xavier Gipson.
Elijah Moore saw 12 targets from Joe Flacco and benefits if Amari Cooper (concussion) is sidelined.
Noah Brown should see steady targets after Tank Dell's season-ending leg injury; Beckham gets more usage with Mark Andrews done for the regular season.
Jonathan Mingo has had six-plus targets in each of his past four games; Xavier Gipson led the Jets with five receptions and 77 yards.

Potential busts are Calvin Ridley, Drake London, Jordan Addison, and Jayden Reed; Ridley faces a Browns unit that allowed the second-fewest FPPG to WRs entering Week 13, and Trevor Lawrence (ankle) is hurt.
Christian Kirk suffered a groin injury on Monday night and is more doubtful than questionable against Cleveland; Demario Douglas (concussion) was ruled OUT for Week 14.
The ranked list runs 82 deep, with Hill, Lamb, St. Brown, A.J. Brown, Keenan Allen, and Jefferson as the top six.
